description: Halfway between the Hôtel des Invalides and the Eiffel Tower, this elegant 82 sqm apartment offers the ideal setting for your stay in Paris.Thanks to its exceptional location, you'll be right on the doorstep of the capital's major cultural sites.Fully air-conditioned and fully equipped, it combines comfort and modernity to welcome up to 8 people in the best conditions.The spaceThis apartment is located on the third floor of a building without elevator. The first thing you'll discover is a magnificent, spacious living room with a comfortable sofa and matching armchairs, as well as a connected TV. The dining area features a beautiful table perfect for 8 people. This refined and bright room invites you to relax. The kitchen, adjoining to the living room, is fully equipped, functional and very practical, perfect for a stay like at home. The master bedroom, isolated for more privacy from the other two, has a king-size bed and its own bathroom with a walk-in shower. This high-standard room is particularly comfortable. The two other rooms each have a Queen-Size bed and a connected TV. The second bathroom has a shower and WC. For more privacy, the apartment also has a separate toilet (two in total in the apartement). For maximum comfort, this apartment is fully air-conditioned, it has a washing-machine, a dishwasher, a microwave, an oven, as well as a Nespresso coffee machine.
